options.name: allow_dup
options.description: Whether to allow starting a duplicate job of the same type. If set to C(false) and a running job of the same type exists, the operation is a no-op.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: job_id
options.description: The ID of an existing job to control. Mutually exclusive with I(job_type). Required if I(job_type) is not specified.

options.name: job_params
options.description: Additional parameters to pass when starting the job.

options.name: job_state
options.description: The desired control state of the job. C(started) - Start a new job (used with I(job_type)). C(paused) - Pause a running job. C(running) - Resume a paused job. C(cancelled) - Cancel a running or paused job.

options.name: job_type
options.description: The type of job to start (e.g. C(SmartPools), C(TreeDelete)). Mutually exclusive with I(job_id). Required if I(job_id) is not specified.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: paths
options.description: List of filesystem paths for the job. Required when starting a new job with I(job_type).

options.name: policy
options.description: The impact policy name to associate with the job.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: priority
options.description: The priority of the job. Must be between 1 and 10.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the job resource. C(present) - Indicates the job should exist or be controlled.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: wait
options.description: Whether to wait for the job to complete after starting it.

options.name: wait_interval
options.description: Interval in seconds between polling for job status during wait.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for job completion.
